newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - June 30.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - June 30.

text.p: -- SBC Communications Inc ended talks regarding a possible merger with AT&T Corp, the Wall Street Journal reported. SBC's stock finished at 59-15/16 Friday while AT&T closed at 35-3/4.
-- J.P. Morgan & Co Inc is talking with mutual fund company American Century about buying 45 percent of the firm for $900 million, the Wall Street Journal said. J.P. Morgan's stock closed at 106-3/4.

-- American General Corp said it would post an after-tax charge of $26 million in the second quarter from the sale of its bank credit card portfolio to a unit of General Electric Co. American General last traded at 48-9/16.

-- Raytheon Co is expected to receive approval from the U.S. Justice Department to go ahead with its buyout of Texas Instruments Inc's defense business if it sells or licenses its chip-making technology to competitors, the Wall Street Journal reported. Raytheon's stock closed at 51-3/8 while Texas Instrument closed at 85-1/4.
